canonical_coverage.capability: Append a file and its sheets/tables to an existing dataset
canonical_coverage.remaining_delta: Bounded synchronous multipart intake keeps dataset identity, requires a durable request key, appends all parsed sections with immutable file/snapshot receipts and canonical table bindings, locks claim/publication, rejects aliases and refuses table-name collisions without replacing prior native tables. Independent native section commits are not an atomic multi-file transaction: failure preserves prior snapshots/objects but blocks dataset query/schema pending reconciliation. Recovery, actual PostgreSQL concurrency and configured-provider/runtime acceptance remain unqualified; the original route is not admitted.
